description: This Java source file defines the class AndroidModuleWizardStep, which extends ModuleWizardStep. It manages the UI and logic for a wizard step in Android project creation within IntelliJ IDEA, including UI initialization, validation, and data model updates.

classes.name: AndroidModuleWizardStep
classes.description: A class extending ModuleWizardStep that manages the UI and logic for an Android module creation wizard step in IntelliJ IDEA.

methods.name: AndroidModuleWizardStep
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wizard step with module builder, modules provider, and project type.

methods.name: disposeUIResources
methods.description: Disposes of UI resources, specifically the Alarm used for updating AVDs.

methods.name: updateStep
methods.description: Initializes the step if not already initialized.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel component of the wizard step.

methods.name: getPreferredFocusedComponent
methods.description: Returns the component to focus when the step is displayed.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets default application and package names based on module name.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the user input, throws ConfigurationException if invalid.

methods.name: updateDataModel
methods.description: Updates the module builder with data from the UI.

methods.name: getHelpId
methods.description: Returns the help ID string for context-sensitive help.
